exact_identifier: Panattoni Park Borehamwood Local Development Order
evidence_slice: Hertsmere Borough Council states that the Local Development Orders for Sky Studios Elstree and Panattoni Park Borehamwood were approved at Full Council on 28 February 2024. The council describes Panattoni Park Borehamwood as a purpose-built distribution depot off Elstree Way, approved in July 2019, comprising four warehouses with associated parking and office space. Part of the site is leased by Sky Studios Limited, and only the part used by Sky is covered by the Panattoni Park Borehamwood Local Development Order. The LDO extends permitted development rights for specified operational development at the covered site.
